# Nicolas Heaton — Hairdresser, Malmesbury

> Precision cutting, colour, and styling in Malmesbury, Wiltshire. A small, independent salon run by appointment — 01666 822158.

Nicolas Heaton is a small, independent hairdresser based at 16 Griffin Alley, Malmesbury. Every appointment starts with a consultation, and appointments are made by phone.
